            (ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j)

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n s W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T +
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 1 W = 0 →
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 2 W = 0 →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 4 W = 0 →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 6 W = 0 →
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 8 W = 0 →
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
                    (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 3 T +
                          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 5 T +
                        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 7 T +
                      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 9 T) +
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W

∀ (s T : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + 1) = ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T + 1 / ↑(T + 1) ^ s

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, 1 / (↑T + ↑k) ^ s

∀ (s T j : ℕ),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / (↑t + ↑j) ^ s =
    ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s j

∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.numerator n t
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseNumerator n).natDegree ≤ 2 * n
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.baseU n).natDegree = 2
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n).natDegree = n + 1
∀ (n : ℕ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n ^ 9).natDegree = 9 * (n + 1)
∀ (a b : ℕ), a ≠ b → IsCoprime ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑a) ^ 9) ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑b) ^ 9)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W).natDegree ≤ 2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W).comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j)

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j * ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j)

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  PowerSeries.constantCoeff ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j (-↑j)
∀ (n j : ℕ), PowerSeries.constantCoeff ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ≠ 0

∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j (-↑j + z)
∀ (j : ℕ) (z : ℚ), Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) = -↑j + z

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedClearedSeries n j W *
      ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j))

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ∀ (t : ℚ),
      (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialNumerator n W

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W t =
    Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W) /
      Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j).comp
      (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j
∀ (n j : ℕ), j ≤ n → (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j).natDegree = n

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n ^ 9 ∣
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W -
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialNumerator n W

∀ (n i j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  j ≤ n → j ≠ i → (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑j) ^ 9 ∣ ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialBlock n i W

∀ (n i j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    j ≠ i →
      Polynomial.X ^ 9 ∣
        (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialBlock n i W).comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    Polynomial.X ^ 9 ∣
      (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W -
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialNumerator n W).comp
        (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.localTruncation n j W).comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑j) =
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9,
      Polynomial.C (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W) *
        (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑j) ^ (9 - s)
∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.localTruncation n j W).natDegree ≤ 8

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  Polynomial.X ^ 9 ∣
    (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.weightedNumerator n W).comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) -
      (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialBlock n j W).comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialBlock n j W).comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j ^ 9 *
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.localTruncation n j W

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  j ≤ n → (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialBlock n j W).natDegree ≤ 9 * n + 8

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialNumerator n W =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialBlock n j W
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ), (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.partialNumerator n W).natDegree ≤ 9 * n + 8

∀ (n j s : ℕ) (W : Polynomial ℚ) (t : ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) →
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W *
                  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j) ^ 9 *
                (t + ↑j) ^ (9 - s) /
              Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ^ 9 =
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W / (t + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.poleProduct n t

∀ (n j : ℕ) (t : ℚ),
  j ≤ n →
    Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) =
      (t + ↑j) * Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapPartialFractions.clearedPolePolynomial n j)
∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℚ), (∀ k ≤ n, t + ↑k ≠ 0) → Polynomial.eval t (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.polePolynomial n) ≠ 0
∀ (P : Polynomial ℚ), PowerSeries.X ^ 9 ∣ ↑P → Polynomial.X ^ 9 ∣ P

∀ (P : Polynomial ℚ) (j : ℕ),
  Polynomial.X ^ 9 ∣ P.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) → (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ↑j) ^ 9 ∣ P
∀ (S : PowerSeries ℚ), PowerSeries.X ^ 9 ∣ S - ↑((PowerSeries.trunc 9) S)
